tool_args.rationale: The five paid rows vary the sign and size of the before/after input contrast and horizon, while the equal-input row isolates the equilibrium contribution. This is sufficient to fit the three parameters of the normalized hysteresis law; an additional probe is not justified.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Reserved for underidentified multi-state memory ODE fits; the observed opposing-step response aligns with the three-parameter normalized before/after contrast model and does not require trajectory data.
